text.c02: [proudly] Ah, the guest from the future! Not since Gifu.
text.c03: [politely] And what have you brought us tonight?
text.c05: [excited] Drink from the future? Splendid — show me!
text.c12: [surprised] Oh… amber, and clear as glass.
text.c13: [proudly] Yamazaki… the foot of Mount Tennō. Let's see.
text.c14: [whispers] …Mm. A sweet scent, right through the nose.
text.c17: [excited] My throat's on fire — and it's delicious! I like it!
text.c18: [politely] Might I have a glass as well?
text.c25: [whispers] …Oh, so cold. It smells of young leaves.
text.c27: [calmly] Excellent. I'd want this on a summer campaign.
text.c28: [whispers] Not fair, Ieyasu hogging it. Hand it here.
text.c35: [proudly] Harmony, eh. That's how I want the realm to be.
text.c36: [calmly] Truly. Come — let us taste it.
text.c50: [teasing] Do people in the future drink this every night?
text.c54: [calmly] The future sounds like a fine age.
text.c56: [proudly] I've got these names by heart.
text.c62: [whispers] …Do bring us more from the future.
text.c64: [whispers] …Next time, I'll be the one treating you.
